blocks.text: Logical operators kai conditions (sharait) ya expressions ko jorte hain. Sab se aam teen hain: and, or aur not. Yeh Boolean values (True ya False) dete hain.

items: and: tab True jab dono True hon.
or: tab True jab kam az kam ek True ho.
not: ulat deta hai; True ko False aur False ko True.

blocks.text:
# Define variables
x = True
y = False
# Logical AND
logical_and = x and  y
print(x , "and ", y ,"=", logical_and) # Output: True and False =False
# Logical OR
logical_or = x or y
print(x , "or " , y , " =", logical_or) # Output: True or False = True
# Logical NOT
logical_not_x = not x
print("not", x, " = " , logical_not_x) # Output not True= False
logical_not_y = not y
print("not", y, "=" , logical_not_y)
# Output:  not False=  True

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab or wali line ke comment mein "True and False = True" chhapti hai. Us line mein operator or hai, is liye sahi "True or False = True" hai.
Is code mein do Boolean variables x = True aur y = False hain. Un par AND, OR aur NOT kiye gaye: True and False = False, True or False = True, not True = False, not False = True.

blocks.prompt: Kitab x or y ke comment mein 'True and False = True' likhti hai. Kya likha hona chahiye?
blocks.explanation: True or False = True: us line mein operator or hai, and nahi.

items: and: dono True; or: koi ek True; not: ulat.
